shortDescription: Manages RR for the VXLAN Network on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: as_number
options.description: Specifies the number of the AS, in integer format. The value is an integer that ranges from 1 to 4294967295.

options.name: bgp_evpn_enable
options.description: Enable or disable the BGP-EVPN address family.

options.name: bgp_instance
options.description: Specifies the name of a BGP instance. The value of instance-name can be an integer 1 or a string of 1 to 31.

options.name: peer
options.description: Specifies the IPv4 address or the group name of a peer.

options.name: policy_vpn_target
options.description: Enable or disable the VPN-Target filtering.

options.name: reflect_client
options.description: Configure the local device as the route reflector and the peer or peer group as the client of the route reflector.
